name: Italian-Style Macaroni Soup with Beef, Carrot, Celery & Bell Pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat. Add the beef and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and cooked through, about 6 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer beef to a plate and set aside. (Reserve pot with drippings for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1.02 kg lean ground beef
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
3 medium carrots
3 sticks celery
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Place in a large bowl.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and medium dice onions. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Return the pot (with drippings) to medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add the veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes.

Return beef to the pot along with broth, tomatoes, pasta, and Worcestershire. Stir to combine the soup, cover, and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer until pasta is cooked through, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2129 ml chicken or vegetable broth
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes
255 g macaroni (elbow) pasta
2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Once the pasta is done, add half of the parsley to the soup and stir to combine. Remove from heat. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving.)
To serve, divide soup between bowls and sprinkle with reserved parsley. Enjoy!
